title: feat(plugin-view): an editable object-view grid selects a cell first and saves each cell on its own

## 维护者速读

- 用自定义对象视图(没有列表页外壳的那种,比如工作室里的视图预览)画出来的可编辑表格,改单元格的方式和列表页一样了:单击选中、双击或回车或直接打字进入编辑、改完一格立刻保存;表格上方不再出现「全部保存」那条保存栏。不可编辑的表格不变,单击仍然打开记录。
- 属于「列表行内编辑重做」专题,把还停在旧保存方式上的表格挪过来,解决同一张表在不同地方保存方式不一样的问题。
- 出错时最坏是这类表格里改完的格子没有立即保存成功,格子会标出失败原因,不会丢改动;可直接撤回本 PR。
- 无

## What changes

`ObjectView`'s default content renderer (route 2: an `object-view` with no `renderListView` host, the shape the Studio's view preview and any authored `object-view` take) mounts `ObjectGrid` directly. Since #35684/#35685 only a host that passes `cellSelection` gets the select-first cell model and the per-cell save; `ObjectView` passed none, so its editable grid kept the pending-changes bar, "Save All" / "Cancel All" and the per-row save column (`ObjectGrid` wires `defaultBatchSave`).

- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`: the `<ObjectGrid>` it draws gets `cellSelection` when the grid node it built is editable (`gridSchema.editable === true`: the named view's `inlineEdit`, else the authored `table.editable`, the relay objectui#10885 / objectui#10976 already made). Nothing else moves: `ObjectGrid` still ANDs that key with the object's inline-edit verdict and the reader's `update` grant.
- **Reading, stated for L1/L2:** select-first is turned on only where the grid is authored editable. A read-only `object-view` grid keeps click-to-open, because the card's reach is "every non-list grid that offers inline edit", a read-only grid draws no Save All, and moving read-only embedded grids off click-to-open is a navigation change the maintainer's scope ruling on #35683 (7035276698) left as it is. `ListView` and the related-list tab, which pass `cellSelection` themselves, are unchanged.

### Read-first answers from the card (main `2b570445`)

Every "Save All" in the UI is `data-table`'s, saved through `ObjectGrid`'s `defaultBatchSave`; no host wires `onRowSave` / `onBatchSave` itself.

| Grid family | Offers inline edit today? | This card |
|---|---|---|
| Related lists | The record page's related **tab** already runs select-first + per-cell save (`RelatedList.tsx`, `cellSelection: true`, #35892; pinned by `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx`). The section and body faces pass no `editable`. | nothing left to move |
| Dashboard tables | No: `object-data-table` renders a plain `data-table` with no `editable` and no save slot. | nothing to move; the card's dashboard pin cannot be written |
| Record picker | No: the built-in table has no `editable`; the `renderGrid` slot has no caller. | nothing to move |
| `ObjectView`'s own grid | Yes (named view `inlineEdit` / `table.editable`) | **this PR** |
| Authored `object-grid` nodes (SDUI, JSX on react pages) | Yes (`editable: true`) | next PR, `Fixes #36270` |

The card's #35590 question: a group-placed master-detail child is edited in `MasterDetailForm` / `LineItemsPanel` (its own grid, saved with the parent by the form), not through `ObjectGrid`'s Save All, so no batch save needs keeping and no ruling is owed.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.perCellSave-36270.test.tsx` (new), real `ObjectGrid` under `ObjectView`: (1) `table: { editable: true }`: select the cell, Enter, type, Enter sends ONE `update(object, 'r1', { name })`, the row shows the new value, and no "Save All" / "Cancel All" and no record form are drawn; (2) a named view's `inlineEdit: true`: the same single update, no "Save All"; (3) control: a read-only grid keeps click-to-open (the record form opens) and selects no cell.
- `ObjectView.tableEditable-10976.test.tsx`, `ObjectView.namedViewInlineEdit-10885.test.tsx`: their probe now selects the cell and presses Enter (the select-first entry) and reads the editor from `td[data-editing-cell]`. The grant cases still open no editor; the click now selects the cell, which says why it cannot be edited, and opens no record.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's "related list" pin is #35892's existing `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx`, cited rather than duplicated. The dashboard-table pin is not written: no dashboard table offers inline edit (table above).
- An authored `editable: true` on a dashboard table widget's options would spread into the `data-table` and stage edits nothing saves; `DataTableSchema.editable`'s jsdoc already names it host-paired and tells authors to use `object-grid`. Pre-existing, not touched, noted for the seat.
- #35827 (retire `onBatchSave`) stays blocked until the next PR lands: authored `object-grid` nodes still call it.

## Verification

Two-minute check: render an `object-view` node with `table: { columns: ['name'], editable: true }` over any object (or open a grid view with inline edit in the Studio's view preview); click a cell, press Enter, type, press Enter: the value saves at once and no "Save All" bar appears.

Files to read first, by risk: `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (the one `cellSelection` spread on the default `<ObjectGrid>`), `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.perCellSave-36270.test.tsx`.
